title: OpenReading Batch Result v0.1
description: The output of a batch run (Manifest v0.6): one envelope covering many documents. Composes the single-document contract — each succeeded item's `response` is a full response.v0.3 envelope (validated independently, M9) — without changing it. Items appear in input order; skips/failures are recorded honestly per item, never silently dropped (deliver-or-warn, M6). schema_version is a per-version const (Canon §8 response-family rule).

state.description: CLOSED enum. succeeded = zero failed items and >=1 succeeded; partial = some succeeded, some failed; failed = zero succeeded (all failed, or everything skipped).

request.description: Echo of the batch-level ask, for provenance/replay.

state.description: CLOSED enum. succeeded → `response` populated; failed → `error` populated; skipped → `skip_reason` populated.

response.description: A full response.v0.3 envelope when state=succeeded (validated independently per M9); null otherwise. Opaque here to keep the batch schema self-contained (no cross-file $ref).

skip_reason.description: CLOSED enum (+null). Why an intake file was not processed (M3).

transport.description: CLOSED enum (+null). How the item was executed — platform fan-out or native batch (M10).

SourceRef.description: Identity of one intake source. `relpath` (path relative to an expanded directory root) is the stable cross-run pairing key for corpus compare; `sha256` is the content-hash identity fallback.

cost_usd.description: Sum over items that reported a cost; absent (null) if none did (M8 — no fake precision).

cost_bases.description: Distinct cost bases observed across items (e.g. ['estimated','metered']).

backends.description: Per-item backend tally (matters for `auto` batches with heterogeneous routing).
